description: Fleet status from OTLP metrics. Filter with the system and lpar variables.

tiles.title: CPU by system
tiles.description: Average INDICATE LOAD utilization. High CPU plus high steal means the LPAR is busy.

tiles.title: Exporter up
tiles.description: 1 when the last Feilong host scrape worked. 0 means do not trust the other tiles.

tiles.title: Paging utilization
tiles.description: Paging pages in use over pages allocated. Trend, not an outage signal.

tiles.title: Spool utilization
tiles.description: Spool pages in use over pages allocated.
